subject: physics

hotspots.label: Position Value
hotspots.description: The object's position measured from the reference point — a distance and a direction, such as +6 m.
hotspots.positionHint: Above the object's spot on the number line, tracking it as the slider moves.
hotspots.function: Reads and labels the object's location relative to the reference point.

hotspots.label: Reference Point
hotspots.description: The fixed 0-marker everything is measured from. Sliding it relabels every position on the line.
hotspots.colorHint: Clear bright-amber marker post at the 0 coordinate.
hotspots.function: Sets the origin all position readings are measured from.

hotspots.label: Direction Arrow
hotspots.description: The arrow from the reference point toward the object shows which side its position is on.
hotspots.colorHint: Head-painted pointer running from 0 to the object, tinted coral.
hotspots.function: Shows positive/negative side so a distance becomes a unique location.

hotspots.label: Coordinate Grid
hotspots.description: Switch the line to a 2D grid and read positions as pairs like (3, 2) — one number per axis.
hotspots.function: Labels positions with a coordinate pair on two axes.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar for math/physics: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props beyond the mat. A long warm-wooden mat runs left-to-right sight, an amber 0 marker stands at the origin, and a bright coral arrow stretches from 0 toward the object. Strong saturated color is reserved for hotspot dots (amber ∕ coral ∕ blue) plus the arrow tint. Soft neutral studio light, no emissives, no bloom.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Mat warm-wooden (roughness ~0.6), number marks are ink-grey floats above the mat, object a simple picket child figure (roughness ~0.85, smooth topology), arrow a thin prism with coral accent. Slider rails soft warm-grey with amber knobs. No emissive material anywhere; readout text lives in the app runtime layer.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the concept of position as a reference-based location, modeled on a sliding-0 number line — decidedly procedural, symmetric-commutative reading (the same relative reading +6/−6 from either marker implies symmetric arrows).

GEOMETRY: a long linear mat (length ~8 units along +x/−x) on the floor at y=0. A 0-position marker is a thin amber post at x=0 on the mat. An object (child or token) sits on the mat at a draggable x in [-5, 5]. An arrow ribbon from the 0 post to the object shows direction and magnitude. A mode layer swaps the line for a flat square (2D) grid in the xz-plane beneath, with an (x, z) readout pair.

INTERACTION: the Object Slider drags the child along the line; the Reference Slider moves the amber 0 post and all position readings recompute relative to it. The Direction/Grid layer toggles the coordinate overlay.

NAMED NODES: NumberLineMat, ZeroPost, ObjectBody, DirectionArrow, GridPlane, ReadoutBadge (app layer). Budget 6–10k triangles, smooth continuous topology, no toon outline.
